title: Get started
body:
Open VN Presence.exe. No installer, .NET runtime or browser engine is needed. Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.

Your games are on the left, the Discord preview is in the center, and your VNDB account controls are on the right.

Updating from the old app? Quit it from the tray before opening this version. Your existing library and preferences are copied on first launch. The old settings file is kept.

More → Guide opens these instructions again.

title: Connect Discord
body:
1. Open Discord on your PC.

2. Go to Settings → Activity Privacy.

3. Turn on Share your detected activities.

Keep Discord and VN Presence running while you play.

title: Add a game
body:
1. Start the game, then press Add

2. In the new window, click your game in the top list. If it isn't there, use Refresh or Browse to its .exe.

3. Check the search title. Version and progress text may be removed automatically. Edit it if needed, or paste a VNDB URL. Press Search.

4. Click the matching result below, then Link.

The window closes and the game is saved. Games and executables already linked can't be added twice.

title: Your games
body:
Select a saved game before using Details or Cover

Use the dropdown above the game list, on the right, to choose Added, Alphabetical or Last played. Your choice is remembered. Last played puts recent games first; history starts when the app records a session.

Moved its folder? More → Change executable updates the path and keeps your settings.

Remove asks you to confirm the title before unlinking it. No is selected by default.

Playing two games? The one you're using takes priority. Switching away keeps the last game on Discord.

title: Discord preview
body:
Select a game to see its cover and activity in the center.

It shows the cover, native title, studio, details and activity buttons. View on VNDB opens its game page. Your profile button is optional.

Start the game to see automatic details and the elapsed timer. Chapter changes keep the timer running.

Live means that game is being shared. Game not running or Not shared means you're only previewing it.

The bottom status shows whether the app is connected to Discord. If Discord is not running, open the desktop app; VN Presence reconnects automatically.

title: Show game details
body:
Pick a game → Details

Automatic uses text from the game's window title:

Kanon January 7th, Thursday
→ January 7th, Thursday

Custom shows whatever you type. Leave it blank to hide the details line.

Preview shows the window title and the final details. Resize the window for longer text. Press Save to apply.

title: Fix a title mismatch
body:
Automatic showing nothing? Start the game and open Details

Copy the game name from Current window title into Window title prefix. Use only the fixed part before the date or chapter.

Example window:
My Game Special Edition — Chapter 2

Prefix:
My Game Special Edition

Leave the field blank to use VNDB's names.

title: Remove unwanted text
body:
In Details → Automatic:

Remove text deletes phrases wherever they appear. Separate them with ;

Ver1.0.0; R18

Trim from edges removes characters only at the ends. Enter - to get:

- long-time-no-see -
→ long-time-no-see

Use -() to trim outer dashes and parentheses. Don't put - in Remove text if you want to keep internal hyphens. Check Result, then Save.

title: Choose a cover
body:
Select a game → Cover

Default uses the main VNDB cover. Release covers offer other editions. Resize the window for longer names.

Select a cover, then Save. Adjust lets you fit the whole cover, crop it, or blur it before uploading.

title: Community covers
body:
Open Cover → Community covers to open a separate list below the release covers. These are covers users have uploaded for the selected game.

Click one to preview it, then Save. You reuse the existing image without another upload.

No community covers yet? Choose a release cover and use Adjust → Upload and use to share your version.

Your new uploads are marked (your upload). Select one and press Remove upload to delete the hosted image after confirmation. Anyone using the same URL may lose their cover. Existing cached copies may remain.

Removal rights stay on this PC. Only the original uploader can remove an image; uploading the same pixels again reuses it.

title: Fit or crop a cover
body:
Cover → select a cover → Adjust

Fit whole cover keeps the entire image with transparent padding. The checkerboard is only a preview.

Untick Fit whole cover to crop. Drag the preview to move the image. Scroll or use Zoom to resize it; arrow keys move it too. Reset recenters it.

Upload and use uploads the image. Press Save in the Cover window to apply it. Save image saves a PNG on your PC.

title: Blur a cover
body:
Cover → select a cover → Adjust

Tick Blur cover for artwork you want to obscure. The preview blurs so you can check it.

Press Upload and use, then Save in the Cover window. The blur is applied before upload, so Discord receives the blurred image.

Save image also saves the blurred version. Transparent padding stays transparent.

Blur is optional; the app does not detect NSFW artwork automatically. Uploaded images are public.

title: Use your own image
body:
Cover → Custom image

Paste a direct image URL, not a webpage or a file on your PC. The image must be publicly accessible.

Save, check the preview, then Save in the cover picker.

Want to change it? Open Custom image again. Clear the URL to remove it.

title: Connect VNDB
body:
Press Connect VNDB at the top of the right panel.

Click Create token on VNDB and log in on the website. Create a token and tick both permissions:
Access private items on my list
Add/remove/edit items on my list

Paste the token into the app and press Connect. You don't give the app your password.

Your profile URL is filled in automatically. Uncheck Show VNDB profile button if you don't want it on Discord.

Windows encrypts the saved token for your user. Disconnect removes the token; your profile button preference stays saved.

title: Profile button
body:
Connect VNDB to use your account's profile link automatically. There is no URL to enter.

The Show VNDB profile button checkbox below Connected as [username] adds a button named Visit [username]’s VNDB profile to your Discord activity. Uncheck it to hide the button while keeping your account connected.

The preview shows the same button. Other people can see it on Discord; Discord hides activity buttons from their owner.

title: Labels and votes
body:
Select a saved game to load its VNDB labels and vote.

Tick or untick a label to save the change automatically. Playing, Finished, Stalled and Dropped are mutually exclusive; choosing one clears the others.

Open Vote to choose a rating. For a decimal, type a value from 1.0 to 10.0, such as 5.6, and press Enter. Typing does not filter the list.

Choose Remove vote to clear an existing score. This also saves automatically.

Connected as [username] stays on its own line. Below the Notes button, Saving to VNDB changes to Saved to VNDB when the update succeeds. There is no Save button.

If you see Not saved, the update failed; change the value again to retry. Wait for Saved to VNDB before quitting.

title: VNDB notes
body:
Connect VNDB, select a game, then click Notes below My vote.

The editor loads the game's existing VNDB note. Type your changes; they save after you pause for a second. Save and close finishes saving any pending changes before closing the editor.

Clear the text to remove the note. Notes are saved to VNDB, not shown on Discord.

If saving fails, your draft stays open. Edit it to retry, or press Save and close to try saving again. Close without saving discards only the remaining unsaved changes.

Notes follow your VNDB list privacy. Notes on public entries can be seen by other people.

title: Back up your settings
body:
More → Export settings saves your games, customizations, and profile to a JSON file.

On another PC, choose More → Import settings and pick that file. Import replaces the saved games and profile after you confirm.

If game folders differ, use Change executable afterward.

The export contains your profile and game paths. Keep it private. Your VNDB token is excluded.

title: Keep it running
body:
Minimize or X hides the app in the system tray without a message. It keeps running and sharing your game.

Double-click the tray icon to reopen it. To quit, right-click the icon → Exit.

Pause stops sharing until you press Resume.

Start with Windows opens the app in the tray when you sign in. Keep the .exe in the same folder.

Your settings stay saved across app versions. More → Guide opens this guide again.
